summary: First iteration testing of Cafe SWM ordering system. All 30 backend pytest cases pass covering auth (admin/admin123, kasir/kasir123), public lists (3 categories, 9 products, 10 tables), order creation with tax 10%, QRIS mock pay, cash pay with change, status updates, admin CRUD on products/categories/tables/employees, sold_out rejection, change-password, profile update, and reports (summary/daily/monthly/yearly + xlsx export). Frontend critical flows verified: customer welcome -> menu (9 products, 3 categories filter, search) -> product drawer -> cart (subtotal/pajak 10%/total + payment method) -> checkout works; admin login redirects to /admin dashboard with KPIs + 14-day area chart; admin /products, /tables (QR rendered, 44 SVGs visible), /reports (tabs + export); kasir login redirects to /kasir dashboard and /kasir/orders lists today's orders with status badges. No critical issues found.

minor.issue: Uses UTC midnight for today filter; in non-UTC timezones early-AM local orders may be missed (cosmetic, not blocking)

issues: Background dark image with light gradient overlay is on-theme; Mulai Pesan button is enabled even when no table selected and only relies on a Pilih nomor meja Select — consider disabling button until table is chosen (currently navigates to /menu only when table set in CartContext; tested via ?meja=01 query that auto-populates)

action_items: Optional: consider local-timezone aware today filter on /api/orders
Optional: explicitly disable Mulai Pesan button until a table is chosen for better UX
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 817-line file. Consider splitting into routers (auth, products, orders, reports) once stable for maintainability.
Admin/Kasir endpoint guards correctly differentiated (require_admin vs require_staff).
Order number format YYYYMMDD-NNNN is generated correctly via count_documents regex prefix.
Tax rounding uses round(.., 2) on subtotal*0.10 which is fine for IDR but could yield .x0 fractions; consider integer math (Math.floor/round to whole Rupiah) if business prefers no decimals.
_id correctly excluded via projection {'_id': 0} everywhere — no Mongo ObjectId leakage.
Frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL via axios baseURL — env-driven, no hardcoded URLs.
seed_data_creation: Backend startup seeds 3 categories (Makanan/Minuman/Snack), 9 products with Pexels images, 10 tables (01-10), and admin+kasir users. All present and verified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (30 tests, 9.5s runtime). Customer flow can be auto-table-selected with /?meja=01. Cart testids: drawer product cards use data-testid prefix 'product-'. Login form testids: login-username/login-password/login-submit. Mock QRIS confirmation endpoint: POST /api/orders/{id}/qris-pay (no auth required).
rca of the issue: No critical bugs identified in this iteration.
